items.markdown:
![Surin Beach Phuket: Relaxed Charm & Royal History](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/07271411-1672-0139-0000-7d2e67214a3d:4)
Surin Beach is `a stunning 800-metre stretch of soft pale sand, deep turquoise water, and natural casuarina shade on Phuket’s west coast` . Following recent local cleanups, the beachfront is now free of commercial stalls and beach clubs, returning to its pristine, natural state.[](https://www.phuket101.net/surin-beach/) [[1]](https://www.phuket101.net/surin-beach/)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/lk_6x6PEcDU)

Geography and Travel Details

- **Location:** Situated on Phuket's west coast between Kamala Beach and Bang Tao Beach.
- **Airport Distance:** Roughly a 30-minute drive (about 22 km) from Phuket International Airport, with taxi costs up to 1,000 baht.
- **Local Travel:** A 15 to 20-minute drive from Patong or Bang Tao. Free parking is available near the main entrance.[](https://www.phuket101.net/surin-beach/) [[1]](https://thailandmagazine.com/phuket/beaches/surin-beach/)[[2]](https://www.thailandretreats.com/Location/Surin)

Best Activities and Conditions

- **High Season (December–April):** Clear turquoise water ideal for swimming, snorkeling, and paddleboarding.
- **Low Season:** Waves can get rough; swimming requires caution.
- **Shade:** Natural cover provided by pine and coconut trees along the sand (no rental chairs or umbrellas are currently permitted on the public beach).[](https://www.tui.co.uk/destinations/asia/thailand/phuket/surin-beach/holidays-surin-beach.html) [[1]](https://www.tui.co.uk/destinations/asia/thailand/phuket/surin-beach/holidays-surin-beach.html)[[2]](https://uk.hotels.com/go/thailand/surin-beach)

expanded_element.description:
Nice beach on crowded island
 Lovely little beach lined with cheap local vendors serving decent food and cold drinks. Very busy in mid-February, but you can still find space on the beach. The water drops off quickly, so in the heat of the afternoon, the water can get a little crowded. The place is overrun by Russians.
